theorem.attribution: Ordered subtraction of two independently replayed existing R2 policy means; project algebraic derivation, no claim of novelty or verbatim external theorem.

literature_scope.role: Aronow–Samii §4 Condition 1 restricts potential outcomes within an exposure class on the design support. The project separately derives each policy mean using conditional mean equality across all assignments with the same signature, positive support for the target signatures, and the required A4 means. The ordered difference then subtracts the two identified policy means.
